judged_text: The new top-level assets embed.css.scss and embed.js are never registered in the asset precompile list; the diff touches no config/application.rb or initializer, and Rails' default precompile pattern only includes files named application.*. In production, `stylesheet_link_tag 'embed'` raises "embed.css isn't precompiled" and /assets/embed.js 404s, so every third-party page embedding comments gets a broken iframe even though the feature works in development.

The diff does not add these files to any manifest (e.g., application.js/css) nor to any precompile configuration (no changes to config/initializers/assets.rb, config/application.rb, etc.). Under Rails’ default production precompile list (typically only `application.*` plus non-js/css), `embed.css`/`embed.js` may not be precompiled, causing missing assets in production for the embed feature.
